0.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_TRANSFORMHLW2022_000_000
0.description: Up to something? Me? Never! I am but a fun-loving imp, here to help my fellow revelers enjoy the Wake! And I can fashion you a <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> convincing guise for the masquerade. Ehehehe...

1.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_TRANSFORMHLW2022_000_001
1.description: All I need is your memory of someone, someone who made a <hex:021A020203>strong<hex:021A020103> impression. Someone unforgettable, someone <hex:021A020203>powerful<hex:021A020103>. Yes, that's it...

2.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_TRANSFORMHLW2022_000_002
2.description: All I need is for you to recall a journey, a journey unforgettable. Traverse your memories, and tell me what you see...

4.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A1_000_001
4.description: A journey to forge this realm anew.

5.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A1_000_002
5.description: A journey to end a conflict of one thousand years.

6.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_TRANSFORMHLW2022_000_003
6.description: Good, good. Now think of someone remarkable you encountered in that time, someone <hex:021A020203>powerful<hex:021A020103>. Yes, that's it...

8.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_001
8.description: A Padjali woman as gentle yet indomitable as nature itself.

9.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_002
9.description: A stalwart Roegadyn woman of unshakable conviction.

10.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_003
10.description: A rugged Hyuran man unmatched in loyalty and valor.

11.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_004
11.description: A charming and compassionate Lalafellin lady of noble birth.

12.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_005
12.description: A courageous and clever Garlean man admired by many.

13.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_006
13.description: A wry and ambitious Garlean man who hates to be outdone.

14.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_007
14.description: An eccentric Miqo'te man crimson of both hair and eye.

15.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_100_008
15.description: A compassionate Hyuran woman who leads a “secret” organization.

16.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_100_009
16.description: A formidable Roegadyn man recognized for his tactical brilliance.

17.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_100_010
17.description: A stunning Miqo'te woman famed as a peerless songstress.

18.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_100_011
18.description: A Hyuran gentleman with an irrepressibly inquisitive nature.

19.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_100_012
19.description: A loyal Miqo'te woman who assists a gentleman inspector.

20.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_100_013
20.description: A Hyuran man who began life anew in a realm reborn.

21.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_009
21.description: A blue-eyed Elezen man with a heart noble and true.

22.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_010
22.description: A tenacious half-Elezen woman who fights for what is just.

23.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_011
23.description: A robed Lalafellin woman of the intellectual persuasion.

24.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_012
24.description: A proud Elezen man unmatched in the art of the lance.

25.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_013
25.description: A daring Hyuran man who lives free as a bird.

26.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_014
26.description: An Elezen man of noble birth fond of gossip and hearsay.

27.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_A2_000_015
27.description: A Hyuran man who turned his gaze heavensward.

29.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_TRANSFORMHLW2022_000_004
29.description: Ehehehe... That will do nicely. Don't worry, this won't hurt much at all! Just close your eyes...

30.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_SYSTEM_000_005
30.description: The transfiguration can be removed by using the “Unveil” action, or by canceling the “Transfiguration” status effect.

31.name: TEXT_FESHLW2022TRANSFORM_00796_TRANSFORMHLW2022_000_010
31.description: Pay no mind to this little imp! I'm <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> busy during the Wake─I've no time for mundane mummers, no.
